description: This file defines a generic test data set class 'StorageDataSetPlain<TGrainKey>' used for storage-related unit tests in Orleans. It provides test data generation methods, including random grain IDs and states, for testing storage mechanisms.

classes.name: StorageDataSetPlain
classes.description: A generic class for providing test data sets for storage unit tests, supporting multiple test cases with random data generation.

methods.name: GetTestData
methods.description: Returns a tuple with test data comprising grain type, grain ID, and grain state based on the test number.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Provides enumeration of test case indices.
